capability: Say where the Noether analogy stops
title: We choose the pins.

hook.picture: Close: the whale shows a pin on the line to a pod (the reviewer). A huge raw-sienna ring is puffed around the pin like a halo.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Your slide says Noether proved our wiki checks. Nothing did.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Two lanes. A borrowed arrow from the upper lane carries a big promise down to the wiki line, three times, accelerating.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Big words bring big promises along.

stakes.body: One overclaim and a careful audience stops trusting the parts that are real.

solution_hint: Say what you borrowed. Say what you chose.

metaphor.body: Upper lane: an evenly spinning ring keeps its amount, so the kept thing follows from the spin. Lower lane: we place pins by hand, and more come from mistakes. The arrows point opposite ways.

steps.picture: Upper lane: the ring spins evenly. Shift it in time and it looks the same, and a small ring beside it keeps the same size. An arrow runs from the even spin to the kept ring.
A chip under the upper lane.
Lower lane: no spin. The whale places three pins by hand onto the wiki line. Here the arrow points from the pins to the line.
steps.words: Physics finds what's kept. We choose it.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.25). A flag pops after a save on the lower lane and turns into a fourth pin. Its arrow points from the flag up to the pins.
steps.words: More laws come from mistakes, not maths.

steps.picture: Both lanes in view: the upper arrow points down, the lower arrow points up.

real_case.claim: noether-resonance-core cites Noether's 1918 theorem only as inspiration for a WebGL field synth with 5 field topologies. The noether-wiki method notes: Noether derives, we choose, so do not overclaim.

honest_limit.picture: A defect with no pin glides through every gate on the lower lane. Nothing chosen covers it.
honest_limit.words: No law covers what nobody named.

ending_pattern.body: The same pin is shown to the same reviewer, now without a halo and with a chip reading Chosen, then checked. The reviewer answers with a tick.
ending_pattern.callback: The puffed halo that popped in bar 2 is gone. The same pin in the same framing now earns a tick.

end_belief.body: Borrow the idea. Never borrow the proof.

beats.picture: Close: the whale shows a pin on the line to a pod (the reviewer). A huge raw-sienna ring is puffed around the pin like a halo.
The pod reads the halo.
The pod pokes the halo and it pops into a small raw-sienna flag.
The pod answers with a cross chip and turns away.
The whale holds the bare pin.
beats.words: No one proved a thing here.

beats.picture: The whale looks at the bare pin. Hold.
Stillness, then SERIES.open title.
Pull back: two lanes. Upper: a ring spinning evenly. Lower: the wiki line with pins. An arrow points down from upper to lower.
Three-times device: a puffed halo slides down the arrow onto a pin. Every 2 beats.
beats.words: Big words bring big promises along.

beats.picture: Two more halos slide down, every beat then every half beat.
Everything stops. The halos fade. The arrow dims to a dotted line.
beats.words: Say what you borrowed. Say what you chose.
beats.sound: First clean signature: a pure fifth.

Wide: the upper lane becomes the resonance field, a shell of glowing field lines that changes shape with the score and cycles through five shapes.
beats.words: Real build: a field synth, inspired, not derived.

beats.picture: Card: Real repo · noether-resonance-core.
Lower lane: the wiki pins, and beside them a small card from the method's own notes.
beats.words: The method's own rule: don't overclaim.

beats.picture: Still, then a slow push. A defect with no pin glides along the lower lane, through every gate, all glowing pass. No physics predicted it and no chosen pin covers it.
beats.words: No law covers what nobody named.

beats.picture: Hold as the defect glides on.
FELT framing (z 1.6). The whale shows the same pin to the same reviewer pod. No halo now. A small chip sits on the pin.

score_self.reason: Mechanical gates N3 N4 N5 N6 N8 N9 S1 and read time pass. Honest and distinctive, but abstract: a stranger may read the two lanes as a physics lesson. The case is a repo, not a run. J1 unrun.
